input.description: Reminds the reviewer when a pull request has waited too long for its review or for SAIL.
steps: 1. At each scheduled run, read the pull request events (github.pr.opened, github.pr.reviewed, github.pr.merged) and the SAIL check results (sail.check.completed) since the last run.
2. For each open pull request still waiting for its review or for SAIL, measure how long it has waited since github.pr.opened or sail.check.completed.
3. For each pull request that has waited longer than the threshold, draft a reminder for its reviewer, naming the pull request and how long it has waited.
4. Do not send any reminder: it only drafts them for the owner to approve.
invariants: It never sends a message, comment or review itself; every reminder is a draft for the owner to approve.
